journeys.title: First-time Self Assessment filers
journeys.description: A calm starting point if Self Assessment is new to you.

steps.prompt: What brought you here today?

options.label: HMRC letter or notice to file
I want to understand the basics
I am worried about a deadline

steps.prompt: How familiar are you with Self Assessment?

steps.summary_template: Starting with Self Assessment can feel overwhelming. We can take it one step at a time: whether you need to register, key deadlines on GOV.UK, and what records to keep. I can explain TaxSimba Self Assessment package prices if you want — no pressure to buy.
follow_ups: Do I need to send a Self Assessment tax return?
When is the Self Assessment deadline?
How do I register for Self Assessment?

journeys.title: Self-employed individuals
journeys.description: Self Assessment, records, and support options for self-employed income.

steps.prompt: Is self-employment your main income or alongside employment?
Are you registered for Self Assessment with HMRC?

steps.summary_template: Self-employed income is usually reported through Self Assessment. Keep business records, note registration and filing deadlines on GOV.UK, and consider National Insurance. I can outline deadlines or TaxSimba SA package prices if helpful.
follow_ups: When do self-employed people need to register for Self Assessment?
What records should self-employed people keep?
What do TaxSimba Self Assessment packages cost?

journeys.title: Sole traders
journeys.description: Tax basics for UK sole traders running their own business.

steps.prompt: Where are you with your sole trade?
Do you keep income and expense records for your sole trade?

steps.summary_template: Sole traders typically report profits through Self Assessment and may need to register with HMRC. Good records make filing easier; MTD for Income Tax may apply later depending on HMRC rules. I can explain SA basics or share TaxSimba package prices without pushing a purchase.
follow_ups: Do sole traders need to register for Self Assessment?
What is Making Tax Digital for sole traders?
What does TaxSimba Self Assessment Simple cost?

steps.prompt: Have you started freelancing this tax year, or have you been self-employed longer?
Roughly, is freelancing your main income or a smaller side income?

steps.summary_template: Freelancers usually need to consider Self Assessment, record-keeping, and National Insurance. I can cover deadlines and registration using GOV.UK sources, or outline TaxSimba SA prices if useful.
follow_ups: Do freelancers need to register for Self Assessment?
When is the Self Assessment deadline?
What does TaxSimba Self Assessment Simple cost?

journeys.title: Landlords
journeys.description: Property income tax basics for UK landlords.

steps.prompt: What kind of property income do you have?

options.label: Not sure how to classify it

steps.prompt: Do you already file Self Assessment for your property income?

steps.summary_template: UK property income is often reported through Self Assessment. Keep records of rent and allowable costs. MTD may also become relevant depending on HMRC rules. I can explain SA basics or share package prices if you want.
follow_ups: Do landlords need to file Self Assessment?
What is Making Tax Digital for landlords?
What records should landlords keep?

steps.prompt: Are you a CIS subcontractor, a contractor, or not sure?
Do you already complete a Self Assessment tax return?

steps.summary_template: CIS deductions are not the final tax position for many subcontractors — Self Assessment often brings everything together. Keep payment and deduction statements. I can explain SA basics from GOV.UK or share support package prices.
follow_ups: Do CIS subcontractors need Self Assessment?
What records should CIS workers keep?
How do CIS refunds work?

journeys.title: MTD enquiries
journeys.description: Understand Making Tax Digital for Income Tax at a high level.

steps.prompt: Are you mainly self-employed, a landlord, or both?
Do you already keep digital records suited to MTD?

steps.summary_template: MTD for Income Tax involves digital records and quarterly updates for eligible people. Exact start dates and thresholds depend on HMRC rules for your situation — always check GOV.UK. I can share TaxSimba MTD plan prices if helpful.
follow_ups: What is Making Tax Digital for Income Tax?
What do TaxSimba MTD plans cost?
How does MTD relate to Self Assessment?

journeys.title: People with multiple income sources
journeys.description: When employment, self-employment, property, or other income overlap.

steps.prompt: Which income types do you have this tax year?
Do you already file a Self Assessment return?

options.label: Not sure if I need to

steps.summary_template: Multiple income streams often mean Self Assessment is needed even if PAYE covers your job. Keep separate records per income type and check GOV.UK for what must be reported. I can explain how returns fit together or share TaxSimba SA and MTD prices if you want.
follow_ups: Do I need Self Assessment if I am employed and have side income?
How do I report rental income with a salary?
What do TaxSimba Self Assessment packages cost?

journeys.title: People who missed deadlines
journeys.description: Calm next steps if a filing or payment deadline has passed.

steps.prompt: What deadline are you worried about?
Have you already filed or paid for this tax year, or not yet?

steps.summary_template: Missing a deadline can be stressful, but filing late is usually better than not filing. Penalties and interest depend on HMRC rules and your facts — check GOV.UK for official guidance. I can explain typical next steps and TaxSimba support options without guaranteeing outcomes.
follow_ups: What happens if I file Self Assessment late?
How do HMRC late filing penalties work?
Can an accountant help after a missed deadline?

journeys.title: Visitors unsure which service they need
journeys.description: A short path to point you toward the right kind of help.

steps.prompt: What are you mainly trying to do?
How hands-on do you want to be?

options.label: Guidance so I can do most of it myself
Someone to handle the return or MTD

steps.summary_template: Based on your goals, Self Assessment packages, MTD plans, or a one-off accountant call may fit — or your TaxSimba dashboard may already be the right place. I can compare package prices and suggest a more specific guided journey if you want to continue.
follow_ups: What is the difference between SA Simple and SA Smart?
What do TaxSimba MTD plans cost?
How does the £99 accountant consultation work?

journeys.title: Existing TaxSimba customers
journeys.description: Get to the right place in your TaxSimba account for support.

steps.prompt: What do you need help with today?

options.label: Status of my tax return or MTD

steps.prompt: Is this urgent (deadline or HMRC letter within days)?

steps.summary_template: The fastest route is usually your TaxSimba dashboard: sign in and use secure messaging to reach your assigned accountant. They can see your account context and reply there. I am not pushing a new paid consultation — your existing relationship is the right channel.
follow_ups: How do I send a secure message to my accountant in the dashboard?
Where do I check my return status?
How do I upload documents to TaxSimba?

journeys.title: Accountant consultation (£99)
journeys.description: Thirty-minute Google Meet with a TaxSimba accountant — booking is a Phase 2 stub.

steps.prompt: What would you like the consultation to focus on?
When are you hoping to speak to someone?

options.label: Flexible over the next few weeks

steps.summary_template: The TaxSimba Accountant consultation is £99 for about 30 minutes by Google Meet. In this Phase 2 build, booking_status is stub — checkout and live scheduling are not wired yet; I can still explain what is included and list the consultation package.
follow_ups: What is included in the £99 accountant consultation?
How long is the consultation and how is it delivered?
When will online booking be available?
